Hi Stephanie,

Quick note from the operations side as we finalize island assignments: island 4B3 sits adjacent to a service alley (north side). The show rules allow elevated signage up to 18ft, but anything above 12ft requires an alleyway clearance form and structural sketch.

Because you're requesting a double-sided elevated pylon at the corner, we need:
- a signed alleyway clearance form (attached to event permit)
- structural sketch showing mounting and wind anchoring
- vendor proof of insurance naming EdgeTech Expo as additional insured

If you can send these by EOD Wednesday we can push your sign through the permit queue and avoid late fees.

Team — quick mounting note from ops perspective:
- Venue rarely allows bolt-down anchors without prior floor core testing; that takes an additional 24–48 hours and a site rep. StandBuilders can do a non-invasive load test but it's a pass/fail.
- Recommended path: proceed with freestanding ballast plan (SignCo spec) and include bolt-down plates as contingency in the permit application. If venue requests bolt-down we will schedule core verification on install day.

I'll prepare a one-paragraph mounting statement for the alleyway clearance form:
"StandBuilders engineered a freestanding aluminum pylon with internal ballast and rated vents. Bolt-down anchor plates are included as contingency; final anchor verification will be performed on install day and tested per venue guidelines."

I'll send the signed statement and a short risk note to Emma by EOD.
